about: Why a REF section has no ported pytest test (or only a parked one). tools/check.py --trace reads it. A key is a section's exact header text, or '*' for every section of the suite without a test. Statuses: 'parked: <milestone>' (a test exists and skips until that milestone), 'skipped: venv' (needs another venv), 'not ported: ...' (Fusion or UI, owned elsewhere), 'deferred: <milestone>' (pure, but its home is a later milestone).
